routes.label: Overview
routes.title: A small site with a deliberately rich visual system.
routes.summary: This deterministic local fixture combines hydrated navigation, repeated structures, responsive layout, and lazy content without contacting the public internet.

routes.label: About
routes.title: Built to reveal how modern pages actually behave.
routes.summary: Semantic regions, typographic levels, custom properties, and interactive affordances remain stable across every capture.

routes.label: Work
routes.title: Component candidates hiding in plain sight.
routes.summary: The card collection repeats one structural pattern with controlled variations in content, imagery, badges, and links.

routes.label: Case study
routes.title: One deeper page for bounded breadth-first crawling.
routes.summary: This nested path is served by the same shell and rendered from the current URL, just like a client-routed application.

routes.label: Contact
routes.title: A quiet endpoint with loud implementation details.
routes.summary: Form controls, labels, borders, focus states, and a second layout density give the extractor more evidence to organize.

cards.title: Hydrated structure
cards.copy: Links and regions arrive after a same-origin JSON request completes.

cards.title: Canonical routes
cards.copy: Fragments, tracking parameters, downloads, and external origins coexist.

cards.title: Computed tokens
cards.copy: Spacing, color, radius, shadow, and typography use reusable CSS variables.

cards.title: Duplicate assets
cards.copy: Two raster URLs intentionally return the exact same response bytes.

cards.title: Lazy evidence
cards.copy: An observed boundary fetches and appends a final content section once visible.

cards.title: Source references
cards.copy: The delivered JavaScript explicitly advertises a public source map.

lazy.title: The bottom of the page arrived only after scrolling.
lazy.copy: This section is fetched through a same-origin JSON endpoint when its IntersectionObserver becomes visible. It should appear exactly once and expand the rendered document height.
